def endpoint(environ):
    port = environ.get("PORT", "8080")
    host = environ.get("HOST", "127.0.0.1")
    port = int(port)
    if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
        raise ValueError(f"Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535, got {port}")
    return f"http://{host}:{port}/health"
